title: A false identity withdrew a proof without refuting its target
statement: Keep sigma=r+1,kappa=r(r+2)/3,alpha=3r/[8(r+2)],beta=r(r-1)/6,u=a^2+c^2,v=b^2+d^2,j=ad-bc,J_r=alpha(u+v-2j)^2+beta u^2+j^2+r u j. For p=psi_xx,q=psi_xy,w=psi_yy,V=[[q,w],[-sigma p,-sigma q]],Q=<J_r(V)>,the ORIGINAL target is kappa<q^3+sigma^2 p^2 q>^2<=4sigma^2<p^2>Q. Completed independent audit reconstructs the all-r>0 real-sign pointwise bound J_r([[Z,Y],[-X,-sigma Z]])>=kappa Z^2(Y+sigma X)^2/(4sigma^2). Its Cauchy consequence bounds DIFFERENT cubic <pqw+sigma^2p^2q>,valid for periodic W2,4. False identity <q^3>=<pqw> fails for psi=cosx+cosy+cos(x+y):0 vs-1/4,with<p^2q>=0. At r1 another exact six-mode field has original cubic6,surrogate0,so no finite multiplicative repair. Producer withdrew closure;these examples are NOT counterexamples to original target. New later direct heat certificate rebuilds original cubic and does not reinstate false identity.

evidence.quote: The important selection is scientific rather than cosmetic. Ultra retrieved an old original inequality and the audit withdrawing its false proof, then applied current compatible-field machinery to that actual target. The earlier certificate bounded a different cubic. The identity equating the two cubic integrals is false on explicit smooth fields, and the audit also supplies fields ruling out a finite multiplicative repair between those cubics. Neither failure refuted the original N901 target. The new code rebuilds the original cubic directly; it does not restore that identity or the failed unchanged general-U transfer.
